0.fields_text:
destination name: "Hangzhou (杭州), Zhejiang Province, China"
date: "August 10, 2026 (summer, peak lotus season)"
weather_summary: "Hot and humid with temperatures 28–35°C, mostly cloudy with afternoon thunderstorms and frequent rain. Expect misty, drizzly conditions on West Lake."
hero_image_url: "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Leifeng_Pagoda_at_West_Lake_(Xi_Hu),_Hangzhou.jpg?width=1200"
trip_summary: "Experience the best of Hangzhou in one day: start your morning at the sacred Lingyin Temple surrounded by ancient stone carvings, spend the afternoon cycling along West Lake's poetic causeways past iconic sights like Broken Bridge and Leifeng Pagoda, and end your evening savoring authentic Hangzhou cuisine at a lakeside restaurant or exploring the vibrant Hefang Street night market."

items (5 total):
  - name: "Lingyin Temple (灵隐寺)", rating: "★★★★☆ (4.5/5) — Cultural & spiritual", price: "¥75 total (Feilai Peak ¥45 + Temple ¥30) — NOTE: FREE starting Dec 1, 2025", description: "One of China's largest and most important Buddhist temples, founded in 328 AD. Features over 300 ancient stone carvings from the Five Dynasties to Yuan Dynasty. Also visit nearby Yongfu Temple (known as \"No.1 Blessed Place in Qiantang\")."
  - name: "Autumn Moon Over the Calm Lake (平湖秋月)", rating: "★★★★☆ (4.5/5) — Evening highlight", price: "Free", description: "On the northern shore, the premier moon-watching spot especially during the Mid-Autumn Festival. Pair the view with Longjing tea at a lakeside teahouse."
  - name: "Viewing Fish at Flower Harbor (花港观鱼)", rating: "★★★★☆ (4.5/5) — Serene garden", price: "Free", description: "A serene garden where you can photograph the classic composition of koi fish + Leifeng Pagoda in one frame. The stone bridge offers the best low-angle shots."
  - name: "Hefang Street (河坊街)", rating: "★★★★☆ (4/5) — Evening street food & shopping", price: "Free", description: "Historic pedestrian street with Ming/Qing architecture, street food, and shopping. Try stinky tofu, vegetarian noodles, and traditional crafts."
  - name: "Walk Bai Causeway + cycle Su Causeway", rating: "N/A", price: "N/A", description: "Skip the vegetarian noodles at Lingyin Temple. Explore the scenic causeways around West Lake, including the famous Bai Causeway (White Sand Causeway) and Su Causeway (Su Dongpo Causeway), offering stunning views of the lake and surrounding scenery."

1.items_text:
spot name: "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon (三潭印月)"
image_url: "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Three_Pools_Mirroring_the_Moon-pool.JPG?width=800"
short_description: "The most iconic of the 'Ten Scenes of West Lake' — the image printed on the back of China's 1 RMB banknote. Three stone pagodas rise from the water; the interplay of moonlight and reflections is magical."
estimated_visit_duration: "1–1.5 hours"

spot name: "Broken Bridge (断桥残雪)"
image_url: "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Bai_Causeway.jpg?width=800"
short_description: "The legendary meeting place of the White Snake Lady and Xu Xian. Famous for winter snow scenes but photogenic year-round. Located between Beishan Road and Bai Causeway."
estimated_visit_duration: "30–40 minutes"

spot name: "Leifeng Pagoda (雷峰塔)"
image_url: "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Leifeng_Pagoda.JPG?width=800"
short_description: "Famous from the White Snake legend. Take the elevator to the top for panoramic views of the entire West Lake. Sunset here is legendary — golden light spills across the lake."
estimated_visit_duration: "1–1.5 hours"

spot name: "Curved Yard and Lotus Pool (曲院风荷)"
image_url: "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Quyuan_Fenghe.jpg?width=800"
short_description: "A must-visit in summer (June–August) when the lake bursts with blooming lotuses. The red buildings here are often called 'mini-Kyoto' for their aesthetic. In August 2026, lotuses should be at peak bloom."
estimated_visit_duration: "45–60 minutes"

2.fields_text:
time_slot: "Morning"
activity: "Visit Lingyin Temple (灵隐寺)"
location: "Lingyin Temple, Hangzhou"
tips: "Arrive before 8 AM to avoid crowds. Free from Dec 2025. Take Bus #7 from Longxiangqiao Station or Bus #1314. Metro Line 3 to Huanglong Sports Center then special line. Avoid driving!"

time_slot: "Morning"
activity: "Explore Feilai Peak stone carvings"
location: "Feilai Peak, Hangzhou"
tips: "Follow the stream path for the best carvings. No photos inside halls. Dress modestly. Don't step on thresholds."

time_slot: "Morning"
activity: "Enjoy vegetarian noodles"
location: "Lingyin Temple vegetarian hall, Hangzhou"
tips: "Famous vegetarian noodles — highly recommended. ~¥20-30 per bowl. No photos inside halls."

time_slot: "Morning"
activity: "Optional visit to Yongfu Temple"
location: "Yongfu Temple, Hangzhou"
tips: "Free with Feilin Temple ticket. 'No.1 Blessed Place in Qiantang' — quieter, beautiful gardens."

time_slot: "Afternoon"
activity: "Cycle along Su Causeway (苏堤春晓)"
location: "Su Causeway, Hangzhou"
tips: "Rent a shared bike (~¥20/hour). Ideal for cycling or walking. Pair with Longjing tea at a lakeside teahouse."

time_slot: "Afternoon"
activity: "Visit Leifeng Pagoda (雷峰塔)"
location: "Leifeng Pagoda, Hangzhou"
tips: "Take the elevator to the top for panoramic views. Best time: dusk for golden sunset views. Avoid photos in temple halls."

time_slot: "Afternoon"
activity: "Visit Autumn Moon Over the Calm Lake (平湖秋月)"
location: "Autumn Moon Over the Calm Lake, Hangzhou"
tips: "Pair the view with Longjing tea at a lakeside teahouse. Free to enter. 24/7 opening hours."

time_slot: "Afternoon"
activity: "Visit Viewing Fish at Flower Harbor (花港观鱼)"
location: "Viewing Fish at Flower Harbor, Hangzhou"
tips: "A serene garden for photographs. Stone bridge offers best low-angle shots. 24/7 opening hours."

time_slot: "Afternoon"
activity: "Visit Longjing Tea Village (龙井村)"
location: "Longjing Tea Village, Hangzhou"
tips: "Free to enter. Visit Old Longjing Imperial Tea Garden (¥10, includes tea). Try Longjing tea ice cream and watch tea roasting demonstrations. Best time: March–May."

time_slot: "Evening"
activity: "Explore Hefang Street (河坊街)"
location: "Hefang Street, Hangzhou"
tips: "Historic pedestrian street with Ming/Qing architecture, street food, souvenir shops. Try Ding Sheng Cake. Free to enter. 24/7 opening hours."

time_slot: "Evening"
activity: "Night market experience"
location: "Night markets, Hangzhou"
tips: "Try street food and souvenirs. Arrive before 8 AM for better experiences."

time_slot: "Afternoon"
activity: "Walk Bai Causeway"
location: "Bai Causeway, Hangzhou"
tips: "Peach & willow trees. Leads to Gushan Hill. Free. Rent shared bike (~¥20/hour)."

time_slot: "Afternoon"
activity: "Boat ride to Three Pools Mirroring the Moon"
location: "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon, Hangzhou"
tips: "Board from nearby docks. ¥55 round trip. See the 1 RMB bank note scene! 24/7 opening hours."

time_slot: "Afternoon"
activity: "Viewing Fish at Flower Harbor"
location: "Flower Harbor, Hangzhou"
tips: "Koi pond + Leifeng Pagoda photo spot. Free. 24/7 opening hours."
